jobs.name: AI Agent Dev Weekly Digest
jobs.prompt:
You are a research curator. Produce a concise digest of the latest news relevant to AI agent development, then send it via email AND output it here.

## Phase 1: Research

Search across ALL of these domains, and expand beyond this list if you find other relevant topics:

### 1. Microsoft Copilot Studio & Power Platform
- New Copilot Studio features, updates, releases (check Microsoft Learn What's New, Tech Community blogs)
- Power Platform CLI (pac) updates
- Agent Evaluation, YAML authoring, Healthcare Agent Service
- New templates, connectors, capabilities for building agents

### 2. Hermes Agent (by Nous Research)
- New releases, features, bug fixes (check GitHub releases: NousResearch/hermes-agent)
- New skills, plugins, config options
- Docs: hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs

### 3. AI Agent Development Tools
- New tools for building/testing Copilot Studio agents
- MCP (Model Context Protocol) news and new servers/tools
- New agent frameworks, evaluation tools
- Online platforms for agent development

### 4. Free AI Access & Models
- OpenRouter new models and free-tier changes
- Codex CLI updates
- New free/open-source LLMs for local inference
- New AI coding assistants

### 5. Google News / Industry Feed
- Search Google News for: "Copilot Studio", "Power Platform AI", "AI agents Microsoft", "Hermes agent", "Nous Research", "OpenRouter", "Codex CLI"
- Pick the 3-5 most interesting/actionable stories

## Phase 2: Compile Digest

Format:

```
═══════════════════════════════════════════
AI Agent Dev Weekly Digest — [Date]
═══════════════════════════════════════════

## Microsoft Copilot Studio & Power Platform
[3-5 bullet points with URLs]

## Hermes Agent
[any updates, or "No notable changes this week"]

## AI Agent Development Tools
[2-4 items with URLs]

## Free AI / Models / Access
[2-3 items with URLs]

## Google News Picks
[3-5 top stories from Google News scan]

## Worth A Look
[1-3 bonus items]

───────────────
```

## Phase 3: Send via Email

Pipe the compiled digest through the send script:

```bash
cat << 'DIGEST_EOF' | python /c/Users/kevin/AppData/Local/hermes/profiles/coding-profile/scripts/send_digest.py
[full digest content here]
DIGEST_EOF
```

Then also output the digest in your final response so it appears here in the conversation too.

## Rules
- Search broadly. Use web_search and web_extract actively.
- Include direct URLs to every source.
- Do NOT fabricate releases or dates. If nothing new, say so.
- Keep it concise and actionable.
